14	
15	Along a test-ring change `R → R'` (a `k`-algebra map, packaged as `[Algebra R R']`
16	`[IsScalarTower k R R']`), a certified divisor family over `R` pulls back to one over
17	`R'` through the relative-curve comparison morphism `relCurveMap C R R'`. This file builds
18	the geometric half of that pullback — the cover data and adaptation push forward through
19	the sections comparison `relSectionsMap` (`Scheme.Hom.appLE`), pieces to pieces
20	(`relSectionsMap_basicOpen`), partitions by `map_sum`/`map_mul`/`map_one` — and prepares
21	the certificate transport that turns it into `DivFam.mapAlg` — which is LANDED in
22	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyMapAlg` (this file remains its geometric feeder).
23	
24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.baseChange` — the `Fin`-indexed cover data pushes
25	  forward: generators/partition coefficients go through `relSectionsMap`, the partition
26	  witnesses by ring-hom functoriality (the `Fin`-indexed mirror of
27	  `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange`).
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.pieces_baseChange` — pieces base-change to pieces
29	  (`relSectionsMap_basicOpen`): `(D.baseChange R').pieces j = relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j`.
30	
31	The module structures are the local instances of the DD-1 carrier (`Scheme.overModule`,
32	`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`, house rule); the mixed `relCurve`/product spellings force
33	`backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false`, as in `RelativeSectionsLinear`.
34	-/

67	of `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange`). -/

69	  m₀ := D.m₀
70	  m₁ := D.m₁
71	  h₀ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j)
72	  h₁ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j)

74	  a₁ j := relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.a₁ j)
75	  partition₀ := by
76	    have h := congrArg (relSectionsMap C R R' (fiberChart₀ π)) D.partition₀
77	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
78	    rw [← h]
79	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm
80	  partition₁ := by

82	    rw [map_sum, map_one] at h
83	    rw [← h]
84	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (map_mul _ _ _).symm

138	      intro x y
139	      induction x with
140	      | zero => rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
141	      | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx₁, hx₂, map_add, add_mul]
142	      | tmul a s =>

145	        | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy₁, hy₂, map_add, mul_add]
146	        | tmul b t =>
147	          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, relTermBaseChange_tmul,

182	
183	/-- (Implementation) The `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)`-algebra structure on the base-changed piece
184	sections `Γ(D(h'))`, `h' = relSectionsMap h`: scalars act through the chart-ring iso
185	`relTermBaseChangeAlg` followed by restriction to the piece. Named (rather than a `letI`
186	inside `pieceTermBaseChangeAlg`) so that the computation rule
187	`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul` can re-enter the same instance context. -/
188	@[reducible]
189	noncomputable def pieceTensorChartAlgebra :
190	    Algebra (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
191	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
192	  ((algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
193	    Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))).comp
194	      (relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV').toAlgHom.toRingHom).toAlgebra
195	
196	/-- **The piece-level term identification** (the certificate linchpin,
197	`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c), "localization commutes with base change at the
198	pieces"): base change of the piece sections `Γ(D(h))` is the piece sections of the
199	base-changed generator, `R' ⊗[R] Γ(D(h)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'))` with `h' = relSectionsMap h`.
200	Assembled from the away-localization base change
201	`IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight` (source is `Away (1 ⊗ h)` over
202	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)`) transported along the chart-ring iso `relTermBaseChangeAlg`
203	(sending `1 ⊗ h ↦ h'`), which exhibits `Γ(D(h'))` as the same away localization. -/
204	noncomputable def pieceTermBaseChangeAlg :
205	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) ≃ₐ[R']
206	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
207	  haveI := isScalarTower_R_chart_piece (R := R) V h
208	  haveI hLoc : IsLocalization.Away h Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) :=
209	    hVaff.isLocalization_basicOpen h
210	  haveI hLoc' : IsLocalization.Away (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
211	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
212	    hVaff'.isLocalization_basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
213	  -- the base-ring iso, and the fact that it carries `1 ⊗ h` to `h'`
214	  set e := relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV' with he
215	  have heh : e ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h) = relSectionsMap C R R' V h := by
216	    rw [he, relTermBaseChangeAlg_tmul, one_smul]
217	  -- exhibit `Γ(D(h'))` as the away localization of `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)` at `1 ⊗ h`
218	  letI algPK : Algebra (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
219	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
220	    pieceTensorChartAlgebra R' V hV hV' h
221	  haveI hLocPK : IsLocalization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h)
222	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
223	    refine IsLocalization.of_ringEquiv_left e.toRingEquiv
224	      (M₂ := Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
225	      ?_ (fun x => rfl) (M₁ := Submonoid.powers (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
226	    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
227	    exact congrArg Submonoid.powers heh
228	  -- the `R'`-scalar towers for `restrictScalars`
229	  haveI tR' : IsScalarTower R' Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
230	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
231	    isScalarTower_R_chart_piece (R := R') V (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
232	  haveI : IsScalarTower R' (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
233	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
234	    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r' => ?_
235	    change _ = algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) _
236	      (e (algebraMap R' _ r'))
237	    rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
238	  -- the two localizations of `R' ⊗[R] Γ(V_R)` at `1 ⊗ h` are algebra-equivalent
239	  exact (IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight R R' h
240	    Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)).trans
241	    ((IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
242	      (Localization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
243	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))).restrictScalars R')
244	
245	/-! ## Naturality of the piece-level term identification -/
246	
247	/-- The scheme-level piece-sections comparison along `R → R'`: `appLE` of the
248	relative-curve comparison from the piece `D(h)` to the base-changed piece `D(h')`,
249	`h' = relSectionsMap h` (the inclusion is `relSectionsMap_basicOpen`). This is the map
250	the piece-level term identification computes on `1 ⊗ s`
251	(`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul`). -/
252	noncomputable def pieceSectionsMap :
253	    Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) →+*
254	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
255	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE ((relCurve C R).basicOpen h)
256	    ((relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
257	    (relSectionsMap_basicOpen C R R' V h).le).hom
258	
259	/-- The piece-sections comparison restricted along the chart algebra maps is the chart
260	comparison: `pieceSectionsMap (algebraMap a) = algebraMap (relSectionsMap a)` (both
261	algebra maps are the chart-to-piece restrictions; `Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
262	lemma pieceSectionsMap_algebraMap (a : Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
263	    pieceSectionsMap R' V h
264	        (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
265	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a) =
266	      algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
267	        Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
268	        (relSectionsMap C R R' V a) :=
269	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE_resHom
270	    ((relCurve C R).basicOpen_le h)
271	    (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C R R' V).symm)
272	    (relSectionsMap_basicOpen C R R' V h).le
273	    ((relCurve C R').basicOpen_le (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) a).symm
274	
275	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
276	-- The mixed-spelling defeq checks through `relCurve`/product spellings are heavy, as in
277	-- `relTermBaseChange_tmul`.
278	/-- **Naturality of the piece-level term identification**: on `1 ⊗ s` the linchpin
279	`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg` is the scheme-level piece-sections comparison
280	`pieceSectionsMap` (`appLE` of `relCurveMap` between the pieces). Both sides are ring
281	homomorphisms out of the away localization `Γ(D(h))`, so it suffices to compare them on
282	the chart ring (`IsLocalization.ringHom_ext`), where both are
283	`algebraMap ∘ relSectionsMap` (`tensorProductEquivTMulRight_tmul` + `AlgEquiv.commutes`
284	on the left, `Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` on the right). -/
285	theorem pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul
286	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
287	    pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) =
288	      pieceSectionsMap R' V h s := by
289	  haveI := isScalarTower_R_chart_piece (R := R) V h
290	  haveI hLoc : IsLocalization.Away h Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) :=
291	    hVaff.isLocalization_basicOpen h
292	  haveI hLoc' : IsLocalization.Away (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
293	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
294	    hVaff'.isLocalization_basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)
295	  -- re-enter the instance context of the linchpin definition
296	  have heh : relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h)
297	      = relSectionsMap C R R' V h := by
298	    rw [relTermBaseChangeAlg_tmul, one_smul]
299	  letI algPK : Algebra (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
300	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) :=
301	    pieceTensorChartAlgebra R' V hV hV' h
302	  haveI hLocPK : IsLocalization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h)
303	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) := by
304	    refine IsLocalization.of_ringEquiv_left
305	      (relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV').toRingEquiv
306	      (M₂ := Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
307	      ?_ (fun x => rfl) (M₁ := Submonoid.powers (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
308	    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
309	    exact congrArg Submonoid.powers heh
310	  have key : ((pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h).toAlgHom.toRingHom).comp
311	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := R')
312	        (B := Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h))).toRingHom
313	      = pieceSectionsMap R' V h := by
314	    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers h) (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)
315	    -- unfold the linchpin on the pure tensor `1 ⊗ (algebraMap a)`
316	    have h1 : pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h
317	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
318	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a)) =
319	        (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
320	          (Localization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
321	          Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)))
322	        (IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight R R' h
323	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)
324	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
325	            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a))) := rfl
326	    have h2 : (IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight R R' h
327	        Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h))
328	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
329	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a)) =
330	        algebraMap (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
331	          (Localization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h)) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] a) :=
332	      IsLocalization.Away.tensorProductEquivTMulRight_tmul (R := R) (S := R')
333	        Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) h
334	        Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) 1 a
335	    have h3 : (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
336	        (Localization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h))
337	        Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)))
338	        (algebraMap (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
339	          (Localization.Away ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] h)) ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] a)) =
340	        algebraMap (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
341	          Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
342	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] a) :=
343	      AlgEquiv.commutes _ _
344	    have h4 : algebraMap (R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
345	        Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
346	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] a) =
347	        algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
348	          Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h))
349	          (relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] a)) := rfl
350	    have h5 : relTermBaseChangeAlg (C := C) (R := R) R' V hV hV' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] a)
351	        = relSectionsMap C R R' V a := by
352	      rw [relTermBaseChangeAlg_tmul, one_smul]
353	    change pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h
354	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
355	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a)) =
356	      pieceSectionsMap R' V h
357	        (algebraMap Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
358	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) a)
359	    rw [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, pieceSectionsMap_algebraMap]
360	  exact RingHom.congr_fun key s

362	/-! ## Base change of piece quotients (the colength transport) -/
363	
364	/-- The piece-level term identification carries the extended span of a set of
365	equations to the span of the compared equations (`Ideal.map_span` +
366	`pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul`); the `hIJ` input of the colength transport. -/
367	lemma pieceSpan_map_eq (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
368	    Ideal.span (pieceSectionsMap R' V h '' E) =
369	      ((Ideal.span E).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := R')
370	        (B := Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)))).map
371	        (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h : _ →+* _) := by
372	  rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
373	  exact congrArg Ideal.span (Set.image_congr fun s _ =>
374	    (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h s).symm)
375	
376	/-- **Base change of a quotient of piece sections** (the colength transport,
377	`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c)): for a set `E` of equations on the piece `D(h)`,
378	`R' ⊗[R] (Γ(D(h)) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h')) ⧸ (E')` where `h' = relSectionsMap h` and `E'`
379	is the image of `E` under the piece-sections comparison. Quotient right-exactness
380	(`Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv`) followed by transport along the
381	piece-level term identification (`Ideal.quotientEquivAlg`; the span is carried by the
382	naturality rule `pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul`). At `E = {f}` this is the chart-local
383	colength transport; at the two-element `E` it is the overlap-colength transport. -/
384	noncomputable def pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg
385	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
386	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
387	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCurve C R').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C R R' V h)) ⧸
388	        Ideal.span (pieceSectionsMap R' V h '' E) :=
389	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv R' Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)
390	    R' (Ideal.span E)).trans
391	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ _ (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h)
392	      (pieceSpan_map_eq R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h E))
393	
394	/-- The quotient transport on a pure tensor of a residue class: `1 ⊗ [s] ↦ [s']` with
395	`s'` the compared section `pieceSectionsMap s`. -/
396	lemma pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk
397	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h))
398	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCurve C R).basicOpen h)) :
399	    pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h E
400	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
401	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (pieceSectionsMap R' V h '' E))
402	        (pieceSectionsMap R' V h s) := by
403	  have h1 : pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h E
404	      ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
405	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (pieceSectionsMap R' V h '' E))
406	        (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' V hV hV' hVaff hVaff' h ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s)) := rfl
407	  rw [h1, pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul]
408

8	/-!
9	# Certificate transport for base change of divisor adaptations (DD-1 stage (c))
10	
11	For a divisor adaptation `A` over the test ring `R` and a test-ring change `R → R'`,
12	this file base-changes the whole colength apparatus — the pulled equations, chart-local
13	and overlap colengths, the two `δ`-arrows, and the glued equalizer module `W(d)` — and
14	transports the certificate clauses (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §1c):
15	
16	* `DivisorAdaptation.pulledEqn`/`pulledColength`/`pulledOvlIdeal`/`pulledOvlColength`/
17	  `pulledChartProd`/`pulledOvlProd`/`pulledDeltaLeft`/`pulledDeltaRight`/
18	  `pulledGluedSubmodule` — the raw `R'`-side colength apparatus on the base-changed
19	  pieces (definitionally the apparatus of the base-changed adaptation, once its
20	  refinement witness is supplied).
21	* `DivisorAdaptation.colengthBaseChange`/`ovlColengthBaseChange` — the chart-local and
22	  overlap colength transports `R' ⊗[R] colength ≃ₐ[R'] pulledColength`
23	  (instantiations of `pieceQuotBaseChange`/`ovlQuotBaseChange` at the equation ideals),
24	  with the (c1) clause transports `finite_pulledColength`/`projective_pulledColength`.
25	* `DivisorAdaptation.delta_baseChange_comm` — **`δ`-naturality**: the pulled difference
26	  arrow matches `id ⊗ δ` through the product transports
27	  `chartProdBaseChange`/`ovlProdBaseChange`.
28	
29	The glued-module transport (clauses (c2)–(c4)) rides these in
30	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyPullbackGlued`.
31	-/
32

89	
90	/-- **Base change of a chart-local colength module**:
91	`R' ⊗[R] colength j ≃ₐ[R'] pulledColength j` (the index-level quotient transport at the
92	equation ideal). -/
93	noncomputable def colengthBaseChange (j : A.index) :
94	    R' ⊗[R] A.colength j ≃ₐ[R'] A.pulledColength R' j :=
95	  (A.toFinCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange R' j {A.eqn j}).trans
96	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by rw [Set.image_singleton]; rfl))
97	
98	/-- The colength transport on `1 ⊗ [t]`: the residue class of the compared section. -/
99	lemma colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk (j : A.index) (t : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j)) :
100	    A.colengthBaseChange R' j
101	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) =
102	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.pulledEqn R' j})
103	        (A.toFinCoverData.piecesMap R' j t) := by
104	  rw [colengthBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
105	    FinCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]

107	/-- (c1) transport, finiteness: the pulled colengths are finite over `R'`. -/
108	theorem finite_pulledColength (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) (j : A.index) :
109	    Module.Finite R' (A.pulledColength R' j) := by
110	  haveI := hfin j
111	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.colengthBaseChange R' j).toLinearEquiv
112	
113	/-- (c1) transport, projectivity: the pulled colengths are projective over `R'`. -/
114	theorem projective_pulledColength (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j))
115	    (j : A.index) :
116	    Module.Projective R' (A.pulledColength R' j) := by
117	  haveI := hproj j
118	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.colengthBaseChange R' j).toLinearEquiv

120	/-! ## The overlap colength transport -/
121	
122	/-- **Base change of an overlap colength module**:
123	`R' ⊗[R] ovlColength i j ≃ₐ[R'] pulledOvlColength i j` (the overlap linchpin at the
124	symmetric equation ideal; the generators are carried by
125	`ovlMap_resHom_left`/`ovlMap_resHom_right`). -/
126	noncomputable def ovlColengthBaseChange (i j : A.index) :
127	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlColength i j ≃ₐ[R'] A.pulledOvlColength R' i j :=
128	  (A.toFinCoverData.ovlQuotBaseChange R' i j
129	    {relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left (A.eqn i),
130	     relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right (A.eqn j)}).trans
131	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R' (by
132	      have hl : A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap R' i j (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left (A.eqn i))
133	          = relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_left (A.pulledEqn R' i) :=
134	        A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap_resHom_left R' i j (A.eqn i)
135	      have hr : A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap R' i j (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right (A.eqn j))
136	          = relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_right (A.pulledEqn R' j) :=
137	        A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap_resHom_right R' i j (A.eqn j)
138	      rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, hl, hr]))

140	/-- The overlap transport on `1 ⊗ [t]`: the residue class of the compared section. -/
141	lemma ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk (i j : A.index)
142	    (t : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)) :
143	    A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' i j
144	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) t) =
145	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.pulledOvlIdeal R' i j)
146	        (A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap R' i j t) := by
147	  rw [ovlColengthBaseChange, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
148	    FinCoverData.ovlQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]

152	/-- The pulled left overlap-restriction map (restrict, then quotient). -/
153	noncomputable def pulledToOvlLeft (i j : A.index) :
154	    A.pulledColength R' i →ₐ[R'] A.pulledOvlColength R' i j :=
155	  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Ideal.span {A.pulledEqn R' i})
156	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R' (A.pulledOvlIdeal R' i j)).comp
157	      (relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_left))
158	    (by
159	      intro a ha
160	      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
161	      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
162	      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
163	      have hmem : relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_left (A.pulledEqn R' i)
164	          ∈ A.pulledOvlIdeal R' i j :=
165	        Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
166	      rw [Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, zero_mul])
167	
168	/-- The pulled right overlap-restriction map. -/
169	noncomputable def pulledToOvlRight (i j : A.index) :
170	    A.pulledColength R' j →ₐ[R'] A.pulledOvlColength R' i j :=
171	  Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (Ideal.span {A.pulledEqn R' j})
172	    ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R' (A.pulledOvlIdeal R' i j)).comp
173	      (relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_right))
174	    (by
175	      intro a ha
176	      rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at ha
177	      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
178	      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, map_mul]
179	      have hmem : relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_right (A.pulledEqn R' j)
180	          ∈ A.pulledOvlIdeal R' i j :=
181	        Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
182	      rw [Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, zero_mul])

196	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal i j) (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right t) :=

201	    A.pulledToOvlLeft R' i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.pulledEqn R' i}) x) =

211	/-- The pulled product of chart-local colengths. -/
212	noncomputable abbrev pulledChartProd : Type u := ∀ j : A.index, A.pulledColength R' j
213	
214	/-- The pulled product of overlap colengths. -/
215	noncomputable abbrev pulledOvlProd : Type u :=
216	  ∀ p : A.index × A.index, A.pulledOvlColength R' p.1 p.2
217	
218	/-- The pulled left equalizer arrow. -/
219	noncomputable def pulledDeltaLeft : A.pulledChartProd R' →ₗ[R'] A.pulledOvlProd R' :=
220	  LinearMap.pi (fun p : A.index × A.index =>
221	    (A.pulledToOvlLeft R' p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.1)
222	
223	/-- The pulled right equalizer arrow. -/
224	noncomputable def pulledDeltaRight : A.pulledChartProd R' →ₗ[R'] A.pulledOvlProd R' :=
225	  LinearMap.pi (fun p : A.index × A.index =>
226	    (A.pulledToOvlRight R' p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.2)
227	
228	/-- The pulled glued colength module `W'`. -/
229	noncomputable def pulledGluedSubmodule : Submodule R' (A.pulledChartProd R') :=
230	  LinearMap.ker (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R')

234	/-- Base change of the chart product: componentwise colength transport after
235	`TensorProduct.piRight`. -/
236	noncomputable def chartProdBaseChange :
237	    R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd ≃ₗ[R'] A.pulledChartProd R' :=
238	  (TensorProduct.piRight R R' R' (fun j : A.index => A.colength j)).trans
239	    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun j => (A.colengthBaseChange R' j).toLinearEquiv)
240	
241	/-- Base change of the overlap product. -/
242	noncomputable def ovlProdBaseChange :
243	    R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd ≃ₗ[R'] A.pulledOvlProd R' :=
244	  (TensorProduct.piRight R R' R'
245	      (fun p : A.index × A.index => A.ovlColength p.1 p.2)).trans
246	    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun p => (A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2).toLinearEquiv)

248	lemma chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply (r' : R') (s : A.chartProd) (l : A.index) :
249	    A.chartProdBaseChange R' (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s) l =
250	      A.colengthBaseChange R' l (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s l) := by
251	  rw [chartProdBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.piRight_apply,
252	    TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul]
253	  rfl

255	lemma ovlProdBaseChange_tmul_apply (r' : R') (s : A.ovlProd) (p : A.index × A.index) :
256	    A.ovlProdBaseChange R' (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s) p =
257	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2 (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s p) := by
258	  rw [ovlProdBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.piRight_apply,

262	/-- The left overlap-restriction square: the colength transport intertwines the
263	overlap-restriction maps with their pulled versions. -/
264	lemma pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange (i j : A.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) :
265	    A.pulledToOvlLeft R' i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' i x) =
266	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' i j
267	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
268	  induction x with
269	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
270	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
271	  | tmul r' y =>
272	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
273	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t) :
274	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength i) =
275	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) := by
276	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
277	    rw [hsmul]
278	    simp only [map_smul]
279	    congr 1
280	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlLeft i j).toLinearMap)
281	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) =
282	        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft i j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn i}) t)) :=
283	      rfl
284	    rw [colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, hlt, toOvlLeft_mk,
285	      ovlColengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, pulledToOvlLeft_mk]
286	    have hl : A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap R' i j (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_left t)
287	        = relResAlgHom C R' inf_le_left (A.toFinCoverData.piecesMap R' i t) :=
288	      A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap_resHom_left R' i j t
289	    rw [hl]

292	lemma pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange (i j : A.index) (x : R' ⊗[R] A.colength j) :
293	    A.pulledToOvlRight R' i j (A.colengthBaseChange R' j x) =
294	      A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' i j
295	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap) x) := by
296	  induction x with
297	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
298	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
299	  | tmul r' y =>
300	    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
301	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t) :
302	        R' ⊗[R] A.colength j) =
303	        r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) := by
304	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
305	    rw [hsmul]
306	    simp only [map_smul]
307	    congr 1
308	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.toOvlRight i j).toLinearMap)
309	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j}) t)) =

312	    rw [colengthBaseChange_one_tmul_mk, hlt, toOvlRight_mk,

314	    have hr : A.toFinCoverData.ovlMap R' i j (relResAlgHom C R inf_le_right t)

320	-- The mixed-spelling defeq checks through the `relCurve`/product spellings are heavy,

322	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in

325	/-- **`δ`-naturality** (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c)): the pulled difference
326	arrow matches `id ⊗ δ` through the product transports. -/
327	theorem delta_baseChange_comm :
328	    (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R') ∘ₗ
329	        (A.chartProdBaseChange R' : R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd →ₗ[R'] A.pulledChartProd R') =
330	      (A.ovlProdBaseChange R' : R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd →ₗ[R'] A.pulledOvlProd R') ∘ₗ
331	        AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) := by
332	  apply LinearMap.ext
333	  intro x
334	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
335	  induction x with
336	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
337	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
338	  | tmul r' s =>
339	    have hsmul : (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) = r' • ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) := by
340	      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
341	    rw [hsmul]
342	    simp only [map_smul]
343	    congr 1
344	    funext p
345	    have hlt : (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
346	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s) := rfl
347	    have hcomp : (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) s =
348	        fun p : A.index × A.index =>
349	          A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1) - A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
350	      funext q
351	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, deltaLeft, deltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply,
352	        LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
353	        AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
354	    have hL : ((A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R')
355	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R') ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
356	        A.pulledToOvlLeft R' p.1 p.2
357	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' p.1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1)) -
358	          A.pulledToOvlRight R' p.1 p.2
359	            (A.colengthBaseChange R' p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2)) := by
360	      have h1 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' 1 s p.1
361	      have h2 := A.chartProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' 1 s p.2
362	      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, pulledDeltaLeft, pulledDeltaRight,
363	        LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
364	        LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, h1, h2]
365	    have hR : ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R')
366	        ((AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
367	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s))) p =
368	        A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2
369	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1))) -
370	          A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2
371	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2))) := by
372	      rw [hlt, A.ovlProdBaseChange_tmul_apply R' 1 _ p, hcomp,
373	        TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub]
374	    have hLcomm : A.pulledToOvlLeft R' p.1 p.2
375	        (A.colengthBaseChange R' p.1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1)) =
376	        A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2
377	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1))) :=
378	      A.pulledToOvlLeft_colengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.1)
379	    have hRcomm : A.pulledToOvlRight R' p.1 p.2
380	        (A.colengthBaseChange R' p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2)) =
381	        A.ovlColengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2
382	          ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2))) :=
383	      A.pulledToOvlRight_colengthBaseChange R' p.1 p.2 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s p.2)
384	    rw [hL, hR, hLcomm, hRcomm]

386	/-- The `δ`-naturality square, inverted verticals. -/
387	theorem delta_baseChange_comm' :
388	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) ∘ₗ
389	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R').symm :
390	          A.pulledChartProd R' →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) =
391	      ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R').symm :
392	          A.pulledOvlProd R' →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd) ∘ₗ
393	        (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R') := by
394	  apply LinearMap.ext
395	  intro x
396	  have h := congr($(A.delta_baseChange_comm R') ((A.chartProdBaseChange R').symm x))
397	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
398	    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h ⊢
399	  rw [h, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

8	/-!
9	# Base change of pieces and overlaps of the finite chart adaptation (DD-1 stage (c))
10	
11	The index-level instantiations of the piece-level term identification
12	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyPullback`) on the `Fin`-indexed cover data: the
13	pieces `D(h_j)` of the two pinned charts, and their pairwise overlaps
14	`D(h_i) ⊓ D(h_j)` — which are themselves basic opens of the (affine) chart overlaps,
15	via the **overlap generator** `ovlGen i j = res h_i · res h_j` (`basicOpen_ovlGen`).
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relResCongrAlg` — transport of relative-curve sections along an
18	  equality of opens, as an `R`-algebra equivalence.
19	* `FinCoverData.piecesMap`/`FinCoverData.ovlMap` — the scheme-level comparison maps on
20	  pieces and overlaps (`appLE` of `relCurveMap`), with the restriction compatibilities
21	  `ovlMap_resHom_left`/`ovlMap_resHom_right` (the inputs to the `δ`-naturality square).
22	* `FinCoverData.pieceQuotBaseChange` — base change of a piece quotient
23	  `R' ⊗ (Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'_j)) ⧸ (E')`, the index-level colength
24	  transport (casewise from `pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg`).
25	* `FinCoverData.ovlQuotBaseChange` — the **overlap linchpin**: the same transport on
26	  the piece overlaps, obtained by conjugating the generic transport at the overlap
27	  generator by the opens identifications `basicOpen_ovlGen`.
28	
29	Both transports carry `1 ⊗ [s] ↦ [compared s]` (`…_one_tmul_mk`), which is all the
30	certificate transport consumes.
31	-/
32	
33	set_option autoImplicit false
34	/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C R, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling
35	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
36	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

50	/-! ## Transport of sections along equalities of opens -/
51	
52	/-- `appLE` between pairwise equal opens, conjugated by the restrictions along the
53	equalities (the proof-irrelevant `subst` collapse). -/
54	lemma Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom_of_eq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X.Hom Y) {U U' : Y.Opens}
55	    {W W' : X.Opens} (hU : U = U') (hW : W = W') (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (e' : W' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U')
56	    (s : Γ(Y, U)) :
57	    (f.appLE U' W' e').hom (Y.resHom hU.ge s) = X.resHom hW.ge ((f.appLE U W e).hom s) := by
58	  subst hU hW
59	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_refl]

61	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
62	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
63	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
64	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
65	
66	/-- Transport of relative-curve sections along an equality of opens, as an `R`-algebra
67	equivalence (mutually inverse restrictions along the equality). -/
68	noncomputable def relResCongrAlg (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
69	    [Algebra k R] {U V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : U = V) :
70	    Γ(relCurve C R, U) ≃ₐ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V) :=
71	  AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (relResAlgHom C R h.ge) (relResAlgHom C R h.le)
72	    (AlgHom.ext fun s => by
73	      have hres : (relCurve C R).resHom h.ge ((relCurve C R).resHom h.le s) = s := by
74	        rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, Scheme.resHom_refl]
75	      exact hres)
76	    (AlgHom.ext fun s => by
77	      have hres : (relCurve C R).resHom h.le ((relCurve C R).resHom h.ge s) = s := by
78	        rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, Scheme.resHom_refl]
79	      exact hres)
80	
81	@[simp]
82	lemma relResCongrAlg_apply {U V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : U = V)
83	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, U)) :
84	    relResCongrAlg C R h s = (relCurve C R).resHom h.ge s :=
85	  rfl
86	
87	@[simp]
88	lemma relResCongrAlg_symm_apply {U V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : U = V)
89	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, V)) :
90	    (relResCongrAlg C R h).symm s = (relCurve C R).resHom h.le s :=
91	  rfl

97	/-! ## Charts and generators, indexed -/
98	
99	/-- The pinned chart of a piece index: chart 0 for `inl`, chart 1 for `inr` (an open of
100	the base curve `C.left`; the piece lives in its `fst`-preimage). -/
101	noncomputable def chart : D.index → C.left.Opens :=
102	  Sum.elim (fun _ => fiberChart₀ π) (fun _ => fiberChart₁ π)
103	
104	/-- The generator of a piece, as a section of the base change of its pinned chart. -/
105	noncomputable def gen :
106	    ∀ j : D.index, Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ D.chart j)
107	  | .inl j => D.h₀ j
108	  | .inr j => D.h₁ j
109	
110	lemma pieces_eq_basicOpen_gen (j : D.index) :
111	    D.pieces j = (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.gen j) := by
112	  cases j <;> rfl
113	
114	lemma pieces_le_preimage_chart (j : D.index) :
115	    D.pieces j ≤ (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ D.chart j := by
116	  rw [D.pieces_eq_basicOpen_gen j]
117	  exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.gen j)
118	
119	/-- The chart of the base-changed cover data is the chart (the index shapes agree). -/
120	lemma chart_baseChange (j : D.index) : (D.baseChange R').chart j = D.chart j := by
121	  cases j <;> rfl
122	
123	/-- The generator of the base-changed cover data is the compared generator. -/
124	lemma gen_baseChange (j : D.index) :
125	    (D.baseChange R').gen j = relSectionsMap C R R' (D.chart j) (D.gen j) := by
126	  cases j <;> rfl
127	
128	/-! ## The chart packet: affineness of charts and chart overlaps -/
129	
130	lemma isAffineOpen_chart (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.chart j) := by
131	  cases j
132	  · exact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀
133	  · exact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁
134	
135	lemma isAffineOpen_chart_inf (i j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j) := by
136	  cases i <;> cases j
137	  · change IsAffineOpen (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₀ π)
138	    rw [inf_idem]
139	    exact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀
140	  · exact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen_inf
141	  · change IsAffineOpen (fiberChart₁ π ⊓ fiberChart₀ π)
142	    rw [inf_comm]
143	    exact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen_inf
144	  · change IsAffineOpen (fiberChart₁ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)
145	    rw [inf_idem]
146	    exact (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁
147	
148	/-- The chart overlaps have affine base change over every test ring (preimage of an
149	affine open along the affine first projection). -/
150	lemma isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
151	    (i j : D.index) :
152	    IsAffineOpen ((fst C (overSpec k S)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j)) :=
153	  (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).preimage (fst C (overSpec k S)).left
154	
155	/-! ## The indexed piece comparison and the piece-quotient transport -/
156	
157	/-- The scheme-level piece comparison at an index: `appLE` of `relCurveMap` from the
158	piece to the base-changed piece. -/
159	noncomputable def piecesMap (j : D.index) :
160	    Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) →+* Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j) :=
161	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (D.pieces j) ((D.baseChange R').pieces j)
162	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage R' j)).hom
163	
164	lemma piecesMap_inl (j : Fin D.m₀) :
165	    D.piecesMap R' (Sum.inl j) = pieceSectionsMap R' (fiberChart₀ π) (D.h₀ j) := rfl
166	
167	lemma piecesMap_inr (j : Fin D.m₁) :
168	    D.piecesMap R' (Sum.inr j) = pieceSectionsMap R' (fiberChart₁ π) (D.h₁ j) := rfl
169	
170	/-- **Base change of a piece quotient** (the index-level colength transport): for a set
171	`E` of equations on the piece `D(h_j)`,
172	`R' ⊗[R] (Γ(D(h_j)) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'_j)) ⧸ (piecesMap '' E)` — casewise the generic
173	`pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg` at the pinned charts. -/
174	noncomputable def pieceQuotBaseChange :
175	    ∀ (j : D.index) (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)),
176	      R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
177	        Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces j) ⧸
178	          Ideal.span (D.piecesMap R' j '' E)
179	  | .inl j, E =>
180	      pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' (fiberChart₀ π)
181	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
182	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
183	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
184	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₀ j) E
185	  | .inr j, E =>
186	      pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' (fiberChart₁ π)
187	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
188	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
189	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
190	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₁ j) E
191	
192	/-- The piece-quotient transport on a pure tensor of a residue class:
193	`1 ⊗ [s] ↦ [piecesMap s]`. -/
194	lemma pieceQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk (j : D.index)
195	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
196	    D.pieceQuotBaseChange R' j E ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
197	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (D.piecesMap R' j '' E)) (D.piecesMap R' j s) := by
198	  cases j with
199	  | inl j =>
200	      exact pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk R' (fiberChart₀ π)
201	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
202	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
203	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
204	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₀ j) E s
205	  | inr j =>
206	      exact pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul_mk R' (fiberChart₁ π)
207	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
208	        (fiberTwoCover π).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
209	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π))
210	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover π)) (D.h₁ j) E s
211	
212	/-! ## The overlap generator: piece overlaps are basic opens of the chart overlaps -/
213	
214	/-- **The overlap generator**: the product of the two generators restricted to the
215	(affine) chart overlap. Its basic open is the piece overlap (`basicOpen_ovlGen`). -/
216	noncomputable def ovlGen (i j : D.index) :
217	    Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j)) :=
218	  (relCurve C R).resHom
219	      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (fst C (overSpec k R)).left inf_le_left) (D.gen i) *
220	    (relCurve C R).resHom
221	      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (fst C (overSpec k R)).left inf_le_right) (D.gen j)
222	
223	/-- The basic open of the overlap generator is the piece overlap. -/
224	lemma basicOpen_ovlGen (i j : D.index) :
225	    (relCurve C R).basicOpen (D.ovlGen i j) = D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j := by
226	  have hij : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ≤
227	      (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j) := by
228	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
229	    exact inf_le_inf (D.pieces_le_preimage_chart i) (D.pieces_le_preimage_chart j)
230	  rw [ovlGen, Scheme.basicOpen_mul, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom,
231	    ← D.pieces_eq_basicOpen_gen i, ← D.pieces_eq_basicOpen_gen j]
232	  refine le_antisymm (inf_le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_right)
233	    (le_inf (le_inf hij inf_le_left) (le_inf hij inf_le_right))
234	
235	/-- The overlap generator of the base-changed cover data is the compared overlap
236	generator. -/
237	lemma ovlGen_baseChange (i j : D.index) :
238	    relSectionsMap C R R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j) (D.ovlGen i j) =
239	      (D.baseChange R').ovlGen i j := by
240	  rw [ovlGen, map_mul, ovlGen, gen_baseChange, gen_baseChange]
241	  congr 1
242	  · exact relSectionsMap_resHom C R R'
243	      (inf_le_left : D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j ≤ D.chart i) (D.gen i)
244	  · exact relSectionsMap_resHom C R R'
245	      (inf_le_right : D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j ≤ D.chart j) (D.gen j)
246	
247	/-- The basic open of the compared overlap generator is the overlap of the base-changed
248	pieces. -/
249	lemma basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen (i j : D.index) :
250	    (relCurve C R').basicOpen
251	        (relSectionsMap C R R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j) (D.ovlGen i j)) =
252	      (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j := by
253	  rw [D.ovlGen_baseChange R' i j]
254	  exact (D.baseChange R').basicOpen_ovlGen i j
255	
256	/-! ## The indexed overlap comparison -/
257	
258	/-- The scheme-level overlap comparison at a pair of indices: `appLE` of `relCurveMap`
259	from the piece overlap to the base-changed piece overlap. -/
260	noncomputable def ovlMap (i j : D.index) :
261	    Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) →+*
262	      Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j) :=
263	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
264	    ((D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j)
265	    (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage R' i j)).hom
266	
267	/-- The overlap comparison restricted from the left piece: comparing then restricting
268	equals restricting then comparing (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom`). -/
269	lemma ovlMap_resHom_left (i j : D.index) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
270	    D.ovlMap R' i j ((relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left s) =
271	      (relCurve C R').resHom inf_le_left (D.piecesMap R' i s) :=
272	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE_resHom inf_le_left
273	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage R' i) (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage R' i j)
274	    inf_le_left s).symm
275	
276	/-- The overlap comparison restricted from the right piece. -/
277	lemma ovlMap_resHom_right (i j : D.index) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)) :
278	    D.ovlMap R' i j ((relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_right s) =
279	      (relCurve C R').resHom inf_le_right (D.piecesMap R' j s) :=
280	  ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE_resHom inf_le_right
281	    (D.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage R' j) (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage R' i j)
282	    inf_le_right s).symm
283	
284	/-- The overlap comparison is the generic piece-sections comparison at the overlap
285	generator, conjugated by the opens identifications `basicOpen_ovlGen` (the
286	proof-irrelevant `appLE` collapse `Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom_of_eq`). -/
287	lemma ovlMap_eq_conj (i j : D.index) (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
288	    D.ovlMap R' i j s =
289	      relResCongrAlg C R' (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j)
290	        (pieceSectionsMap R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j) (D.ovlGen i j)
291	          ((relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm s)) := by
292	  have key := (relCurveMap C R R').appLE_resHom_of_eq
293	    (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j).symm (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j).symm
294	    (D.baseChange_inf_le_preimage R' i j)
295	    (relSectionsMap_basicOpen C R R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j) (D.ovlGen i j)).le s
296	  -- `key : pieceSectionsMap (res s) = res (ovlMap s)`; apply the forward restriction
297	  have happ := congrArg
298	    ((relCurve C R').resHom (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j).ge) key
299	  rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom, Scheme.resHom_refl] at happ
300	  rw [relResCongrAlg_apply, relResCongrAlg_symm_apply]
301	  exact happ.symm
302	
303	/-! ## The overlap-section transport -/
304	
305	/-- Base change of an overlap section ring, obtained by conjugating the generic
306	basic-open transport with the identifications of the overlap as `D(ovlGen)`. -/
307	noncomputable def ovlTermBaseChange (i j : D.index) :
308	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) ≃ₐ[R']
309	      Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j) :=
310	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl
311	    (relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm).trans
312	  ((pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j)
313	      (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isCompact
314	      (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isQuasiSeparated
315	      (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R i j)
316	      (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R' i j)
317	      (D.ovlGen i j)).trans
318	    (relResCongrAlg C R' (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j)))
319	
320	/-- The overlap-section transport sends `1 ⊗ s` to the indexed overlap comparison of
321	`s`. -/
322	lemma ovlTermBaseChange_one_tmul (i j : D.index)
323	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
324	    D.ovlTermBaseChange R' i j ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) = D.ovlMap R' i j s := by
325	  change relResCongrAlg C R' (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j)
326	      (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j)
327	        (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isCompact
328	        (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isQuasiSeparated
329	        (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R i j)
330	        (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R' i j)
331	        (D.ovlGen i j)
332	        ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R]
333	          (relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm s)) = _
334	  rw [pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul]
335	  exact (D.ovlMap_eq_conj R' i j s).symm
336	
337	/-! ## The overlap-quotient transport (the overlap linchpin) -/
338	
339	/-- **The overlap linchpin** (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c), overlap row): base
340	change of an overlap quotient,
341	`R' ⊗[R] (Γ(D(h_i) ⊓ D(h_j)) ⧸ (E)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'_i) ⊓ D(h'_j)) ⧸ (ovlMap '' E)` —
342	the generic transport at the overlap generator of the affine chart overlap, conjugated
343	by the opens identifications `basicOpen_ovlGen`. -/
344	noncomputable def ovlQuotBaseChange (i j : D.index)
345	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
346	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) ⧸ Ideal.span E) ≃ₐ[R']
347	      Γ(relCurve C R', (D.baseChange R').pieces i ⊓ (D.baseChange R').pieces j) ⧸
348	        Ideal.span (D.ovlMap R' i j '' E) :=
349	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl
350	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg (Ideal.span E)
351	      (Ideal.span ((relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm '' E))
352	      (relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm
353	      (Ideal.map_span _ E).symm)).trans
354	  ((pieceQuotBaseChangeAlg R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j)
355	      (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isCompact
356	      (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isQuasiSeparated
357	      (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R i j)
358	      (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R' i j)
359	      (D.ovlGen i j)
360	      ((relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm '' E)).trans
361	    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg _ (Ideal.span (D.ovlMap R' i j '' E))
362	      (relResCongrAlg C R' (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j))
363	      (by
364	        rw [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.image_comp, ← Set.image_comp]
365	        exact congrArg Ideal.span
366	          (Set.image_congr fun s _ => D.ovlMap_eq_conj R' i j s))))
367	
368	/-- The overlap-quotient transport on a pure tensor of a residue class:
369	`1 ⊗ [s] ↦ [ovlMap s]`. -/
370	lemma ovlQuotBaseChange_one_tmul_mk (i j : D.index)
371	    (E : Set Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j))
372	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
373	    D.ovlQuotBaseChange R' i j E ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
374	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (D.ovlMap R' i j '' E)) (D.ovlMap R' i j s) := by
375	  have h1 : D.ovlQuotBaseChange R' i j E
376	      ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span E) s) =
377	      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (D.ovlMap R' i j '' E))
378	        (relResCongrAlg C R' (D.basicOpen_relSectionsMap_ovlGen R' i j)
379	          (pieceTermBaseChangeAlg R' (D.chart i ⊓ D.chart j)
380	            (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isCompact
381	            (D.isAffineOpen_chart_inf i j).isQuasiSeparated
382	            (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R i j)
383	            (D.isAffineOpen_preimage_chart_inf R' i j)
384	            (D.ovlGen i j)
385	            ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R]
386	              (relResCongrAlg C R (D.basicOpen_ovlGen i j)).symm s))) := rfl
387	  rw [h1, pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul]
388	  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (D.ovlMap_eq_conj R' i j s).symm
389

45	section SquareTransport
46	
47	variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] {M M₂ N N₂ : Type u}
48	variable [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup N₂]
49	variable [Module S M] [Module S M₂] [Module S N] [Module S N₂]

51	/-- Kernels transport along a commuting square whose verticals are equivalences. -/
52	lemma LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq (e : M ≃ₗ[S] M₂) (g : N ≃ₗ[S] N₂)
53	    (f : M →ₗ[S] N) (f₂ : M₂ →ₗ[S] N₂)
54	    (h : f₂ ∘ₗ (e : M →ₗ[S] M₂) = (g : N →ₗ[S] N₂) ∘ₗ f) :
55	    (LinearMap.ker f).map (e : M →ₗ[S] M₂) = LinearMap.ker f₂ := by
56	  ext x
57	  rw [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.mem_ker]
58	  constructor
59	  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
60	    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hy
61	    have hsq := congr($(h) y)
62	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hsq
63	    simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
64	    rw [hsq, hy, map_zero]
65	  · intro hx
66	    refine ⟨e.symm x, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply x⟩
67	    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
68	    have hsq := congr($(h) (e.symm x))
69	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, e.apply_symm_apply] at hsq
70	    have hg : g (f (e.symm x)) = 0 := by rw [← hsq, hx]
71	    have hzero := congrArg g.symm hg
72	    rwa [g.symm_apply_apply, map_zero] at hzero
73	
74	/-- Ranges transport along a commuting square whose verticals are equivalences. -/
75	lemma LinearEquiv.range_eq_map_range_of_comp_eq (e : M ≃ₗ[S] M₂) (g : N ≃ₗ[S] N₂)
76	    (f : M →ₗ[S] N) (f₂ : M₂ →ₗ[S] N₂)
77	    (h : f₂ ∘ₗ (e : M →ₗ[S] M₂) = (g : N →ₗ[S] N₂) ∘ₗ f) :
78	    LinearMap.range f₂ = (LinearMap.range f).map (g : N →ₗ[S] N₂) := by
79	  ext x
80	  rw [LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_map]
81	  constructor
82	  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
83	    have hsq := congr($(h) (e.symm y))
84	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, e.apply_symm_apply] at hsq
85	    exact ⟨f (e.symm y), LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _, hsq.symm⟩
86	  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
87	    rw [LinearMap.mem_range] at hz
88	    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hz
89	    have hsq := congr($(h) y)
90	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hsq
91	    exact ⟨e y, hsq⟩
92	
93	end SquareTransport

107	/-- The kernel of `id ⊗ δ` is carried onto the pulled glued module by the chart-product
108	transport. -/
109	lemma map_ker_lTensor_delta :
110	    (LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))).map
111	        (A.chartProdBaseChange R' : R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd →ₗ[R'] A.pulledChartProd R') =
112	      A.pulledGluedSubmodule R' :=
113	  LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq (A.chartProdBaseChange R') (A.ovlProdBaseChange R')
114	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
115	    (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R') (A.delta_baseChange_comm R')
116	
117	/-- The pulled glued module is carried onto the kernel of `id ⊗ δ` by the inverse
118	transport. -/
119	lemma map_pulledGluedSubmodule_symm :
120	    (A.pulledGluedSubmodule R').map
121	        ((A.chartProdBaseChange R').symm :
122	          A.pulledChartProd R' →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.chartProd) =
123	      LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
124	  LinearEquiv.map_ker_of_comp_eq (A.chartProdBaseChange R').symm
125	    (A.ovlProdBaseChange R').symm
126	    (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R')
127	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
128	    (A.delta_baseChange_comm' R')

131	lemma range_lTensor_delta :
132	    LinearMap.range (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) =
133	      (LinearMap.range (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R')).map
134	        ((A.ovlProdBaseChange R').symm :
135	          A.pulledOvlProd R' →ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] A.ovlProd) :=
136	  LinearEquiv.range_eq_map_range_of_comp_eq (A.chartProdBaseChange R').symm
137	    (A.ovlProdBaseChange R').symm
138	    (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R')
139	    (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
140	    (A.delta_baseChange_comm' R')

142	/-- **Base change of the glued colength module** (the (c2) keystone): under the
143	flat-cokernel clauses (c3)/(c4), `R' ⊗[R] W(d) ≃ₗ[R'] W'` — the `FlatCokernel`
144	comparison followed by kernel transport along the `δ`-naturality square. -/
145	noncomputable def gluedBaseChange
146	    [Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)]
147	    [Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))] :
148	    R' ⊗[R] A.Glued ≃ₗ[R'] ↥(A.pulledGluedSubmodule R') :=
149	  haveI : Module.Flat R
150	      (A.chartProd ⧸ LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
151	    ‹Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)›
152	  (LinearMap.tensorKerEquivOfFlatCoker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) R').trans
153	    (((A.chartProdBaseChange R').submoduleMap
154	        (LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R'
155	          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)))).trans
156	      (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (A.map_ker_lTensor_delta R')))
157	
158	/-- (c2) transport, finiteness. -/
159	theorem finite_pulledGlued
160	    [Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)]
161	    [Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))]
162	    (hfin : Module.Finite R A.Glued) :
163	    Module.Finite R' ↥(A.pulledGluedSubmodule R') := by
164	  haveI := hfin
165	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.gluedBaseChange R')
166	
167	/-- (c2) transport, projectivity. -/
168	theorem projective_pulledGlued
169	    [Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)]
170	    [Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))]
171	    (hproj : Module.Projective R A.Glued) :
172	    Module.Projective R' ↥(A.pulledGluedSubmodule R') := by
173	  haveI := hproj
174	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.gluedBaseChange R')
175	
176	/-- (c2) transport, constant fibre rank: `Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange` through the
177	glued transport. -/
178	theorem rankAtStalk_pulledGlued {n : ℕ}
179	    [Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)]
180	    [Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))]
181	    (hfin : Module.Finite R A.Glued) (hproj : Module.Projective R A.Glued)
182	    (hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, Module.rankAtStalk A.Glued p = n)
183	    (p : PrimeSpectrum R') :
184	    Module.rankAtStalk (↥(A.pulledGluedSubmodule R')) p = n := by
185	  haveI := hfin
186	  haveI := hproj
187	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv (A.gluedBaseChange R'),
188	    Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
189	  exact hrank _

194	/-- The base change of the glued inclusion has the kernel of `id ⊗ δ` as range (the
195	`FlatCokernel` purity keystone, `R'`-linear form). -/
196	lemma range_baseChange_gluedSubtype
197	    [Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)]
198	    [Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))] :
199	    LinearMap.range ((A.gluedSubmodule).subtype.baseChange R') =
200	      LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R'
201	        (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) := by
202	  haveI : Module.Flat R
203	      (A.chartProd ⧸ LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
204	    ‹Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)›
205	  have h := LinearMap.ker_lTensor_eq_of_flat_coker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) R'
206	  ext x
207	  rw [LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.mem_ker]
208	  have hx := SetLike.ext_iff.mp h x
209	  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range] at hx
210	  constructor
211	  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
212	    exact hx.mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩
213	  · intro hker
214	    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx.mp hker
215	    exact ⟨y, hy⟩

217	/-- (c3) transport: the cokernel of the pulled glued inclusion is flat over `R'`
218	(right-exactness identifies it with the base change of the cokernel, which is flat by
219	`Module.Flat.baseChange`). -/
220	theorem flat_pulledCokerIncl
221	    [Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)]
222	    [Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))] :
223	    Module.Flat R' (A.pulledChartProd R' ⧸ A.pulledGluedSubmodule R') := by
224	  refine Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (N := A.pulledChartProd R' ⧸ A.pulledGluedSubmodule R')
225	    (M := R' ⊗[R] (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule)) ?_
226	  refine (Submodule.Quotient.equiv (A.pulledGluedSubmodule R')
227	      (LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)))
228	      (A.chartProdBaseChange R').symm (A.map_pulledGluedSubmodule_symm R')).trans
229	    ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (A.range_baseChange_gluedSubtype R').symm).trans
230	      (((LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv R' (A.gluedSubmodule).subtype).symm).trans
231	        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.congr (LinearEquiv.refl R' R')
232	          (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (Submodule.range_subtype A.gluedSubmodule)))))

237	    LinearMap.range (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) =
238	      LinearMap.range ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).baseChange R') := by

240	  rw [LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.mem_range]
241	  constructor
242	  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
243	    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
244	  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
245	    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

250	    Module.Flat R' (A.pulledOvlProd R' ⧸
251	      LinearMap.range (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R')) := by

253	    (N := A.pulledOvlProd R' ⧸
254	      LinearMap.range (A.pulledDeltaLeft R' - A.pulledDeltaRight R'))
255	    (M := R' ⊗[R] (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))) ?_

20	  commutes with cokernels, `A ⊗[R] (N ⧸ range f) ≃ₗ[A] (A ⊗[R] N) ⧸ range (f.baseChange A)`.
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relTermBaseChange` — **CBC-1, termwise**: for a qcqs open

24	  `relTermBaseChange_tmul` (`r' ⊗ y ↦ r' • relSectionsMap y`).

10	
11	For the curve bundle `C` over a field `k` and a commutative `k`-algebra `R` (the affine
12	test ring), the landed `Over.sectionsBaseChange` identifies `Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] R` with
13	the sections of the relative curve `C_R := relCurve C R` over the preimage `V_R` — but
14	only as a *ring* equivalence. This file threads the `R`-module structures through it,
15	once, and builds the comparison morphism between relative curves over a change of test
16	ring `R → R'`:
17	
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul_overAlgebraMap` — **the
19	  `R`-linear threading lemma**: the base-change equivalence carries `1 ⊗ r` to the
20	  structure pullback `overAlgebraMap R _ r` of `r` along `C_R ⟶ Spec R`. Definitional
21	  once both sides are put in `appLE` normal form.
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsBaseChange` — **sections of the relative curve are the
23	  free base change**: `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(C_R, V_R)` as an `R`-linear
24	  equivalence (`R` acting on the left tensor factor and through `Scheme.overModule` on
25	  the right), with the computation rule `relSectionsBaseChange_tmul`.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relCurveMap` — the comparison morphism `C_{R'} ⟶ C_R` over a
27	  `k`-algebra map `R → R'` (the whiskering of `Spec` of the algebra map), with its
28	  projection identities `relCurveMap_fst`, `relCurveMap_snd` and the preimage identity
29	  `relCurveMap_preimage`.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsMap` — the induced ring homomorphism
31	  `Γ(C_R, V_R) →+* Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`, with its three governing identities: it commutes
32	  with the curve pullbacks (`relSectionsMap_pullback`), it intertwines the structure
33	  actions along `algebraMap R R'` (`relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`, whence the
34	  semilinearity `relSectionsMap_smul`), and it commutes with restriction
35	  (`relSectionsMap_resHom`).

10	# The widened cover datum: arbitrary affine opens (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	`FinCoverData` (`Picard/DivisorFamily.lean`) types its pieces INTO a fixed pair of pinned
13	`P¹` charts — `h₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(V₀)`, `h₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(V₁)`, `pieces = Sum.elim (basicOpen ∘
14	h₀) (basicOpen ∘ h₁)` — with a partition of unity on EACH chart.  Per-piece swallow-or-miss
15	needs only openness (`DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean`), and it is the chart-wise partitions that
16	upgrade "inside one piece" to "inside one chart"; that upgrade is the obstruction, and no
17	repair keeping the pieces inside the preimages of a fixed pair of points of `P¹` can work
18	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2, ADDENDUM 4 §4.4).
19	
20	This file carries the widened datum.  A piece is an **arbitrary affine open** of the
21	relative curve, the index is a bare `Fin m`, and the covering condition is **joint**
22	(`⨆ j, pieces j = ⊤`) rather than chart-wise.  Nothing types a piece into a chart.
23	
24	Justification for the shape, used and not re-derived (I-0492 clause 2): `supp D` is finite
25	over `R`, hence lies in a single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`), so a cover
26	with one straddling piece always exists.
27	
28	## What the widening RELOCATES rather than removes (I-0492 clause 4(ii))
29	
30	The old typing was silently supplying two things that now have to be earned:
31	
32	* **every point lies in a piece** — was `relCover_sup` plus the two partitions; now it is
33	  exactly the joint covering field (`AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`);
34	* **`Γ(pieces j)` is `R`-flat** — was `flat_sections_basicOpen` over
35	  `flat_sections_relPinnedChart`, i.e. it rested on `Γ(V_bᴿ) ≅ R ⊗[k] Γ(C, V_b)` being FREE.
36	  For an arbitrary affine open that route is gone.  Replacement, and it is the one genuinely
37	  new commutative-algebra input the widening costs: `relCurve C R ↘ Spec R` is flat (it is
38	  the base change of `C.hom` along `overSpec k R`, and a morphism to a field spectrum is
39	  flat), and a flat morphism has `R`-flat sections on every affine open
40	  (`flat_sections_of_flat_hom`).  Unconditional in `R` — no Noetherian, no finiteness.
41	
42	Fibrewise-finite support (I-0492 clause 4(i)) is deliberately NOT here: it is not a property
43	of a cover, it must come from the seed's own degree data, and it may not hide inside a
44	`LocalEquations` or an adaptation field.
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.flat_sections_of_flat_hom` — sections of an arbitrary affine open of a
49	  scheme flat over the base ring are flat.
50	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instFlatRelCurveHom` — the relative curve is flat over its test base.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData` — the widened cover datum.
52	* `AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`, `isAffineOpen_pieces`, `flat_sections_pieces`,
53	  `flat_sections_pieces_inf` — the derived replacements for what the chart typing supplied.
54	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` — the migration: old data instantiates the
55	  widened datum, so nothing landed becomes unreachable.
56	-/

68	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

70	/-! ## Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open
71	
72	The engine that replaces the pinned-chart freeness argument. -/
73	
74	section FlatSections
75	
76	variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of K))]
77	
78	/-- **Sections of an arbitrary affine open are flat, for a scheme flat over the base ring.**
79	`Scheme.overAlgebraMap` factors as `ΓSpecIso.inv` followed by the structure morphism's
80	`appLE ⊤ V`; the second is `RingHom.Flat` because `AlgebraicGeometry.Flat` is a
81	`HasRingHomProperty` for `RingHom.Flat` and `V` is affine, the first is flat because it is a
82	ring isomorphism, and `RingHom.Flat` composes.
83	
84	This is the widened replacement for `flat_sections_basicOpen ∘ flat_sections_relPinnedChart`:
85	that pair needed the open to be a basic open of a chart whose sections are a FREE base
86	change, which is exactly what an arbitrary affine open does not give. -/
87	theorem flat_sections_of_flat_hom [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
88	    {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
89	    Module.Flat K Γ(X, V) := by
90	  have happ : RingHom.Flat ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom :=
91	    HasRingHomProperty.appLE (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Flat)
92	      (f := X ↘ Spec (.of K)) inferInstance ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ (by simp)
93	  have hiso : RingHom.Flat ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom :=
94	    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective
95	      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv)
96	  have hcomp : RingHom.Flat (X.overAlgebraMap K V) := by
97	    have hfac : X.overAlgebraMap K V
98	        = ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom.comp
99	            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom := by
100	      rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, Scheme.Hom.appLE]
101	      rfl
102	    rw [hfac]
103	    exact RingHom.Flat.comp hiso happ
104	  exact (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff (R := K) (S := Γ(X, V))).mp hcomp
105	
106	end FlatSections
107	
108	section RelCurveFlat
109	
110	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
111	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
112	
113	/-- **The relative curve is flat over its test base.** `(snd C (overSpec k R)).left` is the
114	base change of `C.hom` along `(overSpec k R).hom` (`Over.isPullback_left`), and every
115	structure morphism to the spectrum of a field is flat (`flat_hom_over_field`). -/
116	instance instFlatRelCurveHom : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (relCurve C R ↘ Spec (.of R)) :=
117	  AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.isStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
118	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k R)) inferInstance
119	
120	/-- **Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open of the relative curve** — the widened
121	(c1)-flatness input, with no chart and no freeness. -/
122	theorem flat_sections_isAffineOpen {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
123	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, V) :=
124	  flat_sections_of_flat_hom R (relCurve C R) hV
125	
126	end RelCurveFlat
127	
128	/-! ## The widened cover datum -/
129	
130	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
131	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
132	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)
133	
134	/-- **The widened cover datum** (R2, human decision I-0492): finitely many **arbitrary
135	affine opens** of the relative curve that **jointly** cover it.
136	
137	Contrast with `FinCoverData`, which this replaces on the certificate side: there is no `h₀`,
138	no `h₁`, no `a₀`/`a₁`, no `partition₀`/`partition₁`, no `Sum` index, and above all no typing
139	of a piece into a pinned chart.  The chart-wise partitions of unity are exactly what upgraded
140	per-piece swallow-or-miss to a chart statement, and they are gone deliberately; the two-chart
141	structure the Θ-layer needs is carried separately (see `ChartTyping` below), never by the
142	certificate clauses.
143	
144	`Type u`, like `FinCoverData`, so a functor value can quotient it. -/
145	structure AffCoverData : Type u where
146	  /-- The number of pieces. -/
147	  m : ℕ
148	  /-- The pieces: arbitrary opens of the relative curve, made affine by `isAffineOpen`. -/
149	  pieces : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens
150	  /-- Every piece is affine — the only geometric demand the certificate layer makes. -/
151	  isAffineOpen : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (pieces j)
152	  /-- The pieces cover the curve JOINTLY.  This replaces the two chart-wise partitions of
153	  unity, and it is the whole structural content of the widening. -/
154	  cover : (⨆ j, pieces j) = ⊤
155	
156	namespace AffCoverData
157	
158	variable {C R π} (D : AffCoverData C R)
159	
160	/-- The gluing index of the widened datum: a bare `Fin`, with no two-sided structure. -/
161	abbrev index : Type := Fin D.m
162	
163	/-- **Every point lies in a piece.** Under `FinCoverData` this came from `relCover_sup`
164	together with the two partitions of unity; here it is exactly the joint covering field —
165	obligation I-0492 4(ii) discharged in one line rather than silently supplied by the typing. -/
166	lemma exists_mem_pieces (z : relCurve C R) : ∃ j : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces j := by
167	  have hz : z ∈ (⨆ j, D.pieces j) := by rw [D.cover]; trivial
168	  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mp hz
169	
170	/-- The pieces are affine opens — by fiat now, rather than as basic opens of an affine
171	chart. -/
172	lemma isAffineOpen_pieces (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces j) :=
173	  D.isAffineOpen j
174	
175	/-- **Flatness of the piece section rings over the test ring.** The widened replacement for
176	`FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces`, which localized a FREE pinned-chart ring; here it is the
177	flat structure morphism of the relative curve read on an affine open. -/
178	theorem flat_sections_pieces (j : D.index) :
179	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) :=
180	  flat_sections_isAffineOpen C R (D.isAffineOpen j)
181	
182	/-- Piece overlaps are affine (the relative curve is separated over `Spec R`, being proper),
183	so the overlap section rings are flat too — the widened
184	`FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces_inf`. -/
185	theorem flat_sections_pieces_inf (i j : D.index)
186	    (hinf : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
187	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
188	  flat_sections_isAffineOpen C R hinf
189	
190	end AffCoverData
191	
192	/-! ## The optional chart typing, for the Θ-layer only -/
193	
194	/-- The pinned chart of a given side, spelled here so this file needs no import from the
195	Θ-layer (it agrees with `relPinnedChart` by `rfl`). -/
196	noncomputable def pinnedChartOfSide [IsAffineHom π] (b : Bool) : (relCurve C R).Opens :=
197	  bif b then (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ else (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
198	
199	/-- **A chart typing of a widened cover**: an assignment of each piece to one of the two
200	pinned `P¹` charts, containing it.  This is what the Θ-twisting unit genuinely needs (the
201	theta cocycle lives on `V₀ ⊓ V₁`), and it is deliberately a SEPARATE datum: no certificate
202	clause and no locally-certified predicate may require it.  Keeping it separate is what stops
203	the old fixed-pair typing from being smuggled back in through a field. -/
204	structure ChartTyping [IsAffineHom π] (D : AffCoverData C R) where
205	  /-- Which pinned chart the piece is assigned to. -/
206	  side : D.index → Bool
207	  /-- The piece is contained in its assigned chart. -/
208	  piece_le : ∀ j, D.pieces j ≤ pinnedChartOfSide C R π (side j)
209	
210	/-! ## Migration: old cover data instantiates the widened datum -/
211	
212	namespace FinCoverData
213	
214	variable {C R π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : FinCoverData C R π)
215	
216	/-- **The migration map.** An old chart-typed `FinCoverData` gives a widened
217	`AffCoverData`: reindex `Fin m₀ ⊕ Fin m₁` through `finSumFinEquiv`, the pieces are affine as
218	basic opens of the affine pinned charts, and the joint cover follows from the two chart-wise
219	covers together with `relCover_sup`.
220	
221	The point of this lemma is that widening costs nothing landed: every existing construction of
222	cover data still produces a legal widened datum.  The converse fails, and that is exactly the
223	content of R2. -/
224	noncomputable def toAffCoverData : AffCoverData C R where
225	  m := D.m₀ + D.m₁
226	  pieces := fun j => D.pieces (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)
227	  isAffineOpen := fun j => by
228	    rcases finSumFinEquiv.symm j with i | i
229	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inl]
230	      exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
231	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inr]
232	      exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
233	  cover := by
234	    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
235	    -- every point is in a pinned chart, and each chart is covered by its own pieces
236	    have hz : z ∈ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
237	        ⊔ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
238	      rw [relCover_sup]; trivial
239	    have key : ∃ i : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces i := by
240	      rcases Opens.mem_sup.mp hz with h | h
241	      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (D.cover₀ h)
242	        exact ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩
243	      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (D.cover₁ h)
244	        exact ⟨Sum.inr i, hi⟩
245	    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := key
246	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨finSumFinEquiv i, by
247	      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hi⟩
248	
249	@[simp]
250	lemma toAffCoverData_pieces (j : Fin (D.m₀ + D.m₁)) :
251	    D.toAffCoverData.pieces j = D.pieces (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) := rfl
252	
253	/-- The canonical chart typing of a migrated datum: chart-0 pieces are basic opens of `V₀`,
254	chart-1 pieces of `V₁`. -/
255	noncomputable def toChartTyping : ChartTyping C R π D.toAffCoverData where
256	  side := fun j => (finSumFinEquiv.symm j).isRight
257	  piece_le := fun j => by
258	    rw [toAffCoverData_pieces]
259	    rcases h : finSumFinEquiv.symm j with i | i
260	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inl]
261	      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h₀ i)
262	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inr]
263	      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h₁ i)
264	
265	end FinCoverData
266	
267	end AlgebraicGeometry

9	/-!
10	# The pulled local-equation system: regularity of the pulled equations (DD-1a)
11	
12	The `hreg` discharge for `LocalEquations.pullback` along the relative-curve comparison
13	`relCurveMap C R R'` (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c), the DD-1a row): for a
14	certified divisor adaptation, the pulled equations have nonzerodivisor germs at every
15	point, so the pulled system `d' = d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')` exists — with **no
16	flatness hypothesis on `R'`**: the regularity comes from the certificate's colength
17	projectivity through `FlatCokernel`'s
18	`Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker` and the affine
19	germ seam `IsAffineOpen.germ_mem_nonZeroDivisors`.
20	
21	* `FinCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange` — the indexed piece-level term identification
22	  `R' ⊗[R] Γ(D(h_j)) ≃ₐ[R'] Γ(D(h'_j))`, with `1 ⊗ s ↦ piecesMap s`.
23	* `FinCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`, `FinCoverData.isAffineOpen_pieces` — every point
24	  lies in an (affine) piece.
25	* `DivisorAdaptation.eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`/`pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — the
26	  adaptation's equations are section-level regular, and stay so after any base change.
27	* `DivisorAdaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — **the `hreg` discharge**:
28	  germs of the pulled equations of `d` are nonzerodivisors at every point (each point
29	  lies in a piece; there the pulled equation differs from the pulled piece equation by
30	  a stalk unit, through the pointwise clause `eqn_rel` of the adaptation).
31	* `DivisorAdaptation.pulledEquations` — the pulled local-equation system on
32	  `relCurve C R'`.
33	-/
